name: Paracetamol (Crocin)
how_to_take: Take one tablet with water. Do not exceed 4 tablets in 24 hours.
disclaimer: This is general information, not medical advice. Always read the package instructions.

name: Ibuprofen
dosage: 400mg every 6-8 hours with food, maximum 1200mg per day
how_to_take: Take one tablet with a full glass of water and food. Do not take on empty stomach.
disclaimer: This is general information, not medical advice. Take with food. Consult a doctor if symptoms persist.

name: Aspirin
how_to_take: Take one tablet with water after food. Do not chew.
disclaimer: This is general information, not medical advice. Do not use if allergic to aspirin.

name: Cetirizine
how_to_take: Take one tablet with water, preferably in the evening.
disclaimer: This is general information, not medical advice. May cause drowsiness. Do not drive if drowsy.

name: Ambroxol Cough Syrup
dosage: 5ml (one teaspoon) three times daily for adults
how_to_take: Take 5ml syrup with water, three times a day. Shake well before use.
disclaimer: This is general information, not medical advice. Continue for at least 5-7 days.

name: Antacid Suspension
composition: Magnesium Hydroxide 200mg + Aluminum Hydroxide 200mg per tablet
dosage: 1-2 tablets three times daily or after meals
how_to_take: Take tablet with water after meals. Chew or let dissolve in mouth.
disclaimer: This is general information, not medical advice. Avoid spicy or oily food.

name: Ranitidine
dosage: 150mg once or twice daily, preferably before meals
how_to_take: Take one tablet with water before breakfast or before bed.
disclaimer: This is general information, not medical advice. Use for 2 weeks maximum without doctor's advice.

name: Metoclopramide
dosage: 10mg three times daily, 30 minutes before meals
how_to_take: Take one tablet with water 30 minutes before eating.
disclaimer: This is general information, not medical advice. Consult doctor if vomiting persists.

name: Vitamin C
how_to_take: Take one tablet with water after breakfast.
disclaimer: This is general information, not medical advice. Vitamin C is not a cure, only a supplement.

name: Loperamide
dosage: 2mg after each loose motion, maximum 6 tablets per day
how_to_take: Take one tablet with water after loose motion.
disclaimer: This is general information, not medical advice. Drink plenty of water. Stop if condition worsens.
